name: Citizenship Restoration (Trở Lại Quốc Tịch)

qualifying_event.description: A person who previously lost Vietnamese citizenship may apply to have it restored, per Article 23 of the Law on Vietnamese Nationality, if they fall within one of several eligible categories.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of former Vietnamese citizenship and its loss; documentation supporting the specific eligible category claimed.

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant is seeking repatriation to Vietnam, has Vietnamese family members, has made a special contribution to Vietnam, or is making a qualifying investment.
A person who was stripped of Vietnamese citizenship (as opposed to having voluntarily renounced it) must wait at least 5 years before reapplying.
requirements.fix_path: Wait 5 years from the date of being stripped of citizenship before reapplying.

evidence_required.document: Proof of former Vietnamese citizenship and the circumstances of its loss
Documentation supporting the specific eligible category (family ties, contribution, investment, or repatriation intent)

sources.title: Government Portal (chinhphu.vn) -- Law No. 24/2008/QH12 on Vietnamese Nationality, Article 23: restoration of citizenship for eligible former citizens; 5-year wait for those stripped of citizenship

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Vietnam). STATUS: DRAFT -- the article's existence and the 5-year post-stripping wait are tier-1 and directly quoted, but the four eligible categories were returned only as a paraphrased list rather than the article's exact wording, and no income/residence/exam conditions specific to this route (as opposed to standard naturalisation) were confirmed -- disclosed as a documentation gap rather than assumed identical to vn_citizenship_naturalisation.json's standard conditions. dual_citizenship_allowed is set true as a modeling assumption for this route specifically (most restoration cases plausibly overlap with the family/descent categories covered by vn_citizenship_relaxed_naturalisation.json's 2025 dual-citizenship allowance) rather than an independently confirmed figure -- flagged as an assumption.
